packages.name: Premium Wash
packages.subtitle: Quick exterior clean
notes: Quick exterior-focused clean
Main image changes with vehicle size
packages.best_for: A maintained vehicle that mainly needs a clean exterior, glass, wheels, and a tidy dash reset.
packages.chooser_prompt: Choose this when the outside needs a tidy reset but the interior is already in decent shape.

packages.name: Basic Detail
packages.subtitle: Quick interior clean
notes: Quick interior-focused package
Main image changes with vehicle size
packages.best_for: Light daily-use interior dust, crumbs, glass, seats, and mats when deep shampoo is not the main goal.
packages.chooser_prompt: Choose this when the cabin needs a tidy reset, not a full stain or odour recovery.

packages.name: Complete Detail
packages.subtitle: Our #1 choice
notes: Best all-around package
Main image changes with vehicle size
packages.best_for: The safest all-around choice when both the inside and outside need attention or the customer is unsure.
packages.chooser_prompt: Choose this when you want the best all-around detail or the vehicle has mixed interior and exterior needs.

packages.name: Interior Detail
packages.subtitle: Full interior detailing
notes: Interior-only full detailing package
Main image changes with vehicle size
packages.best_for: Seats, carpets, mats, cargo areas, salt, kid messes, pet hair, odours, or interior-only recovery.
packages.chooser_prompt: Choose this when the inside is the problem area and shampoo or deeper interior work may be needed.

packages.name: Exterior Detail
packages.subtitle: Full exterior detailing
notes: Exterior-only full detailing package
Main image changes with vehicle size
packages.best_for: Paint, trim, wheels, glass, road film, surface prep, gloss, wax/sealant, clay, or coating-prep discussions.
packages.chooser_prompt: Choose this when the outside finish, protection, or paint prep is the main goal.

addons.name: Full Clay Treatment
notes: Add-on service not included in any package

addons.name: Two Stage Polish
notes: Quote required because paint condition varies

addons.name: High Grade Paint Sealant
notes: Longer-lasting gloss

addons.name: UV Protectant Applied on Interior Panels
notes: Interior panel dressing

addons.name: External Ceramic Coating
notes: Starting price only

addons.name: External Graphene Fine Finish
notes: Starting price only

addons.name: Pet Hair Removal
notes: Recommended when pet hair is embedded in carpets, seats, cargo areas, or mats.
Final price may change for severe buildup.

addons.name: Odor Treatment
notes: Best for smoke, food, pet, musty, or unknown odour concerns after source cleaning.
Severe or biohazard odours may require inspection or referral.

addons.name: Seat Shampoo
notes: Greatly improves many fabric stains and spills, but some permanent staining may remain.

addons.name: Carpet Shampoo
notes: Recommended for salt, coffee, kids, pets, cargo dirt, and winter buildup.
Heavy salt may require multiple passes.
addons.customer_goal: Clean carpets, mats, and cargo areas

addons.name: Salt Stain Treatment
notes: Local Ontario winter add-on for white salt staining on mats, carpets, and lower panels.
Some older salt staining may only improve, not fully disappear.

addons.name: Headlight Restoration
notes: Improves cloudy, yellowed, or oxidized headlight lenses where the lens is restorable.
Cracked, wet, or failing lenses may need replacement.

addons.name: Windshield Ceramic Coating
notes: Adds hydrophobic protection to exterior glass after cleaning and prep.
Best after exterior detail or glass polishing when needed.

addons.name: Ceramic Spray Protection
notes: Entry-level gloss and water-beading protection after an exterior wash/detail.
Not the same as a multi-year ceramic coating.

addons.name: Trim Restoration
notes: Improves faded exterior plastic trim where the material is still restorable.

addons.name: Bug and Tar Removal
notes: Helps remove bug residue, tar spotting, sap-like contamination, and stuck-on road grime before protection.

addons.name: Truck Box Wash
notes: Quote path for pickup beds, work trucks, contractor vehicles, farm trucks, and cargo use.
Loose debris and hazardous materials must be removed before service.

addons.name: Fleet Vehicle Add-On
notes: For multiple vehicles at one location, work trucks, company cars, and recurring business cleanup.
addons.customer_goal: Quote multiple vehicles at one location
